SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-02-2026 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FARAKAR, AMIR HOSSEIN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT UBER TECHNOLOGIES, INC. $1,000.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,000.00, FOR THE INTENTIONAL INFLICTION OF EMOTIONAL DISTRESS. PLAINTIFF WAS WITHOUT PAYMENT FOR SEVEN WEEKS, FORCING HIM TO BORROW MONEY TO PAY RENT, INSURANCE, AND COST OF LIVING EXPENSES. DEFENDANT FAILED TO PROPERLY COMMUNICATE WITH PLAINTIFF, THUS LIMITING HIS ABILITY TO COMMUNICATE. ALL THESE ACTS APPEAR INTENTIONAL TO THE COURT BY THE DEFENDANT.
